- [ascii-literal-construction] Create a row-by-row character source first, then rasterize it in a fixed grid with a monospaced font.
- [ascii-density-hierarchy] Use glyph density, negative space, and permitted foreground brightness to distinguish the subject, paths, and distance.
- [ascii-grid-alignment] Pad every row consistently to the fixed column count and align each glyph to one cell; do not vary font size locally to fake depth.

REQUIREMENT: Return only the source grid for the deterministic rasterizer.

scope.description: Construct the complete game scene from literal printable ASCII glyphs placed in a fixed grid, then rasterize each glyph cell deterministically.
limitations: The selected character set does not include Chinese, block-drawing characters, or emoji.
Do not ask a standard image generator to repaint the grid or add pictorial detail.

pillars: Every visible scene shape is made from literal characters.
Fixed cells and glyph density organize silhouettes, space, and depth.
Foreground, environment, and important interactions remain readable within the permitted glyph and color budget.

rules.instruction: Create a row-by-row character source first, then rasterize it in a fixed grid with a monospaced font.
rules.observable: Every scene mark can be traced to a specific row, column, and glyph.
rules.reject_when: The image is a conventional painting with a glyph texture, or contains independent graphics outside the grid.

rules.instruction: Use glyph density, negative space, and permitted foreground brightness to distinguish the subject, paths, and distance.
rules.observable: The main subject reads at thumbnail size, and enlarged regions remain composed of separate character cells.
rules.reject_when: Random glyph noise obscures the subject, or color alone separates every important object.
rules.avoid: random character noise obscuring the subject

rules.instruction: Pad every row consistently to the fixed column count and align each glyph to one cell; do not vary font size locally to fake depth.
rules.observable: Row and column coordinates remain stable, while spatial differences come from symbols and layout.
rules.reject_when: A proportional font breaks alignment, or local stretching distorts glyphs into shapes.
rules.avoid: proportional fonts or local character stretching

joint_checks.instruction: Keep the new subject readable through glyph density and negative space while preserving literal characters and a uniform grid.
joint_checks.observable: The subject is recognizable, every mark belongs to a glyph cell, and the grid stays aligned.

review.note: Successful compilation is not image-quality validation or a maturity upgrade.
